• You can set up this unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, if another friendly unit was set up in the tunnels below with the 'Tunnel Skulkers' ability, you can set up that unit wholly within 6" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.
